content:
Not for [MARCA]. Lots of people suggested this for my ADHD and if anything it overwhelmed me by giving me another “job” to do. It also triggered shame spirals whenever I failed to log into the app and categorize things. “Fixing” the app would take HOURS. 

I do not recommend this app at all and regret the money I spent on it.

I needed to reduce my cognitive load. Not add to it. Still looking for an app that acts like an assistant and handles the actual budgeting part for me.
Overly complicated, zero automation. Overly complicated, zero automation. Why am I paying if I'm doing everything manually
Not helpful. Not helpful. Account balance takes too long to update and is inaccurate 98% of the time

Home tab sucks and gets in the way.. The new home tab is useless for me and really gets in the way of letting me see my plan. Let me hide the tab all together, or at least rearrange the tabs so it’s not the first one.

Overpriced. I used it when it was free.
I used it when it cost a little.
I even used it when it cost a little more.

But then these greedy idiots priced themselves out of their own market.
Bye, [NOME].

Learning curve. The learning curve is absolutely monstrous with this app. The free trial is so that you don’t pay for something you don’t know how to use yet. I don’t even know what to complain about because this app is so unbelievably confusing and the way it reads different account  just doesn’t make any sense and is baffling.

Confusing and useless. The first thing that happens is that you’re told you’re wildly over budget and you can only fix it by borrowing against the next month. There no help, the instructions don’t match what you see. It’s the opposite of reassurance. Absolutely hated it.

A bit Confusing. For the most part it’s great. But sometimes the balances aren’t accurate and the credit transactions double between 2 cards. But it’s probably me setting it all up wrong. Again, confusing.
Why does an app have an intro cutscene. I had to go through it twice just to realize this is a paid only app. now it has my email for no reason. thanks a lot
Synching issues with banks. Unresolved for months

Design team please stop. Design team thinks we are dumb and that we don’t know how to add icons to our own account names. Nobody has Chk….1234 as their account name. And if they did, it’s likely the way they wanted it. And for all the accounts that are not linked, you still forced a non-descript dollar bill as the “logo”. How does that help? Stop forcing your whims that are completely arbitrary on to your customers. Give me the option to turn off these very unhelpful logo detractors. When I have a savings and checking with the same bank, you still have the same logo. And why do I need more company brand logos in my life?  Let me turn them off!!
Login Issues. I can’t login on my iPhone!
Imports need work. Linking always off if managing a lot of cards. Not a good time. Find otherwise.
May have issue with bank connection. Tried to connect my bank account. Got flagged as suspicious activity and locked my account. Spent 2 hours on the phone getting it figured out

[MARCA] gets more frustrating over time. I’m a longtime [APP] user. I’ve adapted to the radical changes they’ve made to the app over the years, but the fact that you can no longer add a transaction when viewing an account is insane and extremely frustrating. Auto-import isn’t perfect and doesn’t work with every account, so when I’m viewing an account and notice a missing transaction (or several), I should be able to add it while viewing that account’s transaction register. This was always doable but now impossible. There’s absolutely no reason to remove this ability.
Makes no sense. Nothing is intuitive or makes any sense.  No idea what it’s doing or how exactly to use it.  Makes zero sense. Canceled my free trial after 30 minutes was so frustrated.

Many issues despite paying. I have so many problems with this app. The biggest being that I am spending money on this app and the features I pay for do not work. Namely, any feature that requires connection to my bank account. For about half the time I’ve been paying for this app (4 months) my bank account activity would take over a week to update. But for weeks now, [APP] will not even connect to my bank account. I also find the interface quite awkward and unintuitive to use. It’s the type of thing you’ll probably need [MARCA] tutorials to understand.
Awful. The most frustrating app I’ve ever used. I couldn’t get it even with ChatGPT’s help.

Best budget software ever. Been using for many years.
I still like it but I get frustrated bc it quit importing automatically my credit card
Transactions. They said mine wasn’t on the list anymore. Little frustrating. I have to do it manually which can’t do on my phone. Either get out laptop or iPad. Doing it on the iPad is cumbersome. Need to have an easier way to import transactions manually

Charged for a subscription I never signed up for.. [APP] charged me for a subscription I didn’t sign up for. I never even opened it or used it beyond the day I downloaded it and didn’t even finish setting it up- so I asked for a refund and was denied. An app that’s supposed to help you save money instead took money from me. I’m so over every single app being a subscription now. Do not recommend.

UI is too slow. Every time they release an update they add more and more useless animations to menial tasks. The end result is a task that should only take a couple seconds taking close to a minute with the constant wait for an unnecessary visual confirmations. When I adjust amounts just change the number and move. Don’t make me wait for a slider to move followed by a sparkle then take me back to the other adjustments and make me wait another second before I can move on. Give an option to shut it all off and if that already exists make it obvious where that setting is. I just want to balance my budget and get on with my life.

Charged a subscription for a year without permission. I been charged for a year subscription without I am buying it. I requested refund but it will take 24-48 hours and extra works for me to get my money back. WTH

Not for everyone. I had a stressful year and purchased a year subscription to this app. I told myself I would sit down at some point and teach myself how to use it properly. I never did, and now my subscription is about to expire. I played around with it here and there, but I never really enjoyed using it. I guess what im saying is, if you feel like the app isn’t for you, don’t force a year subscription. Just go with something that feels more compatible.

Not what I expected. This app is not what I expected. I already have all the bills and amounts of them written down. I know how much I’m spending and what is coming in. I expected this app to take all my finances and tell me where I was spending too much or what I could do to spend less. Instead, this app just list everything that I already know it offers no advice or ideas, even after having access to all my finance bank account and investment accounts. So disappointed with this app truly thought it would tell me something I already didn’t know. Instead, it just digitalize everything I have written down.

This is overwhelmingly complicated.. Was looking for something simple. I watched a 2 hour [MARCA] video to set this up and try to understand all the different screens. Still can’t see what bills were paid, what money is left and how much am I spending on excess stuff or how much I could be setting aside for the future if I would just spend less on something. I grew up using spreadsheets on a computer. So this one isn’t for me.
Broke the layout. Been a [APP] customer of over 10 years and the new mobile layout is trash plus they’ve been raising the prices and I’m tapped out
Pop up ads. I don’t pay over $100 a year to be served pop up ads

[APP] since 2019. The recent June 2026 [MARCA] changes are horrendous. Revert back to inflow/outflow at the top and also not having a “show more” at the bottom for the flags and the cleared button. The [MARCA] management team should be fired. Back to 5 stars when you revert.

WAS a good app. Stop making the UI worse. Most recently they changed an essential part of a transaction. Something that must be selected for every single one. To a drop down menu instead of showing both outflow and inflow. Taking it from one click to two. I am trying to input transactions on the fly. This is not helpful

Love the program, can’t stand the app.. I’ve been using [APP] for 5 years now, and it has been life changing. Sadly, the app has slowly gotten worse and worse. The browser version is still great, but the app team continues to make unnecessary UI changes that make budgeting and entering transactions on the go take more clicks. Each time I think they can’t make it take longer, they find a way to. I’m incredibly disappointed with the direction that the app is going. Most recently, the enter transaction screen has added a drop down menu to change from inflow to outflow, and included transfer and credit card payment. Nobody is asking for this, and all this did was make entering transactions more cumbersome. Please fix these unnecessary UI changes.

Latest update. UPDATE: NEW [LOCAL] means MORE CLICKS to make anything happen. Ugly colors aside, this is NOT a user friendly upgrade.

[APP] will no longer connect to my bank through Plaid or Mx, and customer service gave up and told me to go manual. Manual works, but I shouldn't have to do this.


UPDATE January 2026: [APP] is not as sleek or as quick to use as it once was. However, their customer service email staff did respond to my problem quickly and fixed my issue quickly. So the customer service was excellent. Now we just need the people in charge of the app design to get back to a philosophy of minimum taps to get to what you want and move the bloat off the front page and out of the budgeting process and into a different screen or remove bloat entirely.

UPDATE September 2025: I just unsubscribed due to the latest update's obfuscating and time wasting nonsense. It's not about "MuScLe MeMoRy." It's about wasting my time and making it take more clicks and eye-tracking to accomplish simple tasks.

App is even worse now. Been using this app for years, and it progressively gets more unnecessarily complex without adding any useful features.

It takes EVEN MORE TAPS to do what you used to be able to do in one or two. Pointless sliders, affirmations, and other time consuming nonsense force me to spend more time on this app than ever before. Some idiot executive probably wants us spending all out time in [APP], but the whole reason I liked it to begin with is because it made tracking my budget fast and easy.

Way too much white space now. App is actually harder to read visually. Update 8/5/2021: PLEASE get rid of Ready to Assign. I will never use this, and it takes up space on the screen. I now have to scroll to after clicking an item to be able t see the item as I allocate money to it. To be budgeted was perfect. Stick with what works.
horrible update. why does [APP] always come out with these stupid updates
Hate that I now have to click “show more” before adding a flag to an item on IPhone/Ipad.. See above

User Interface Disaster. Every update is adding more clicks and removing workflows I’ve done for years with [APP]’s software.  It’s making me consider moving away from [APP] - and I’m a 13 year customer.

Latest update makes things more complex. This is a budgeting app. Why do you have to click more than once to be able to choose if it’s an inflow or outflow? To make matters worse, instead of a one press of inflow or outflow, there are now FOUR options. Talk about confusing. 

It seems like they are tracking some internal KPI about how often a user presses buttons on the app so they made it more complex for the users. Simplicity used to be the key with this app. The last few updates have been terrible. 

Additionally, you now have to press “show more” if it’s a recurring transaction or to clear transactions. [APP], what the heck are you doing? Long time user here that is finally getting fed up from the price increases and terrible UI updates to the app.

Insanely bad UX changes. I’ve been a [APP] user and subscriber for about six years. The [APP] service itself is fine, but I hate the app. The only thing that has really been consistent in all this time is the frequent changes made to the app that completely discombobulate the UX way more often than should happen. Having worked in product management and design myself, I get it, you always want to experiment with improvements and users aren’t going to love every change. What I find frustrating about the [APP] app team’s approach is that they keep making major changes to locations of frequently used functions in the app or completely changing user flows with little to no explanation. I find it hard to believe that these changes are improving anyone’s experience with this app. I feel like every time I sort of get used to the current workflow, they redesign it again. This most recent update has tucked a bunch of frequently used functions, like marking transactions as cleared, behind an extra click inside the transaction summary. It is an infuriating extra step and unnecessary friction. Why would you possibly need to make it harder for people to mark their transactions as cleared? That isn’t a destructive process that needs to be hidden. 

I find myself using the app less and less these days and just going back to the website which changes much less often. Maybe that’s the developers’ goal? Who knows. I find it especially frustrating that the experience on the app does not mirror the experience of the UX on the website, and that is probably the biggest sin that these developers have commit committed. As a user, I should be able to seamlessly switch back-and-forth between desktop and Mobile and the UX should be an afterthought. I should not be having to consciously think about and dissect the user flows to re-orient every time I try to use your product. Budgeting is annoying enough as it is, stop trying to reinvent the wheel and just keep the UX consistent. PLEASE.

Latest Update. June Update: and now there are even more taps needed! I can’t even search for the account/credit card now when doing transfers or payments and have to scroll instead. As someone who has many different accounts it just keeps adding layers of frustration. The [MARCA] team really seems to be purposefully neglecting function.

Original: Just updated and really disliking how many extra clicks are involved. I started using [APP] for its simplicity, but now feel that the [MARCA] updates over the last several versions are making it more difficult to find/enter the basic functions which were the original appeal.

Enough with adding additional taps. Been a user for years, I’m absolutely sick of the UI adding additional taps. Hiding the cleared toggle is particularly egregious, for gods sake stop designing the app around looking good on screenshots first. 

Also I’m not sure what the book ad was for, I was under the impression this was an ad free app.

I’m out. I’ve been a user for almost 10 years now, but I can no longer support this app. It started years ago with random rate hikes and has cumulated into terrible AI customer service, changes and updates for the sake of changes and updates that make the program harder and worse to use, to surprise layoffs of beloved members of the social media team in a terrible economy. The CEO is so completely out of touch and the company gives zero effs what the users want. It’s been years of being ignored but I’m done - there are plenty of other options for much less money. This program was life changing for me but I cannot support them any longer.
Recent updates ruined it. I love [APP] but the most recent update makes everything require an extra click or two just to mark transactions as cleared. Awful.

Directionless. I can’t believe how this company has lost its core. I’ve used [APP] since 2016 and I’ve never seen such poor updates. They’re aimless and pushing advertisements despite paying over $100 per year to use this service. I’ll be cancelling.

App keeps getting worse. [MARCA] updates keep happening for no clear reason. They make the app slower (long animations, pauses during tragedies) and harder to use (hiding features, burying functionality). [MARCA] has taken a backseat to pretty screenshots

Another horrible [MARCA] update. Another update that added more taps to enter transactions. Why is there multiple taps to go from intake to spending? What was wrong with the old enter transaction screen?
Stop with the changes. Product team is bored and keeps making useless changes which complicate the [MARCA] for no good reason.

Changing just to change. Their latest [MARCA] updates are garbage. Whoever designed it should be fired because they literally made it take longer and be more inconvenient to use. Genuinely amazing how they manage to ruin a product for no reason.

Poor Design Changes. The gradual downgrade of the design and features of this app that make entering transactions more time-consuming, plus firing their main marketers, and making you pay for info sessions (after paying for the app) just makes it a poor experience overall. The leadership team has gotten greedy and are sacrificing the customer experience for $. I no longer recommend this budgeting app to others.

UI mess. Every time they update the UX gets worse. There's so much visual clutter and they keep adding extra taps to do things. Bank syncing usually works fine but sometimes gets delayed for days. The Home page is useless and half of the Reflect tab is useless and that's 40 percent of this very expensive app that keeps raising prices.

UI/UX getting worse over time. Every few months they change core parts of the UI that degrade the experience. What used to take a couple seconds and clicks to do now takes 5x that amount. Multiply that by thousands of transactions and re-training muscle memory. I wish they would stop trying to fix what isn’t broken. I firmly believe the [MARCA] designers do not use this app.

Gone downhill & showing now ads. Been a [APP] subscriber for nearly a decade. A simple app that performed exactly what you wanted has become bloated and laggy, not to mention a massive pain to use & navigate. The UI, and therefore the UX, has changed drastically for the worse. Just get back to your roots. And don’t ever show another cross-sell notification advertising the CEO’s new “book”. I pay for this app, I don’t want to see ads of any kind

The app is no longer worth it! Pop up ads in paid sub? Nope!!!. What happened to [APP]? It’s not the same app anymore! [MARCA] changes that makes things more difficult, increasing subscription prices, and now POP UP ads in a $130 subscription. Nope - not having it. I’m going to zero out my [APP] subscription category and find something that will work for my Actual Budget!
Mobile app is not great. I use the desktop version on [APP], way simpler and easy to use. The mobile version gets constant updates and seems to just be getting worse.

Price hike HORRIBLE updates. They doubled the price - shady shady shady - move to something else.

Constant updates that make the 
Product worse.  You have to click a separate screen to CLEAR a transaction.  HORRIBLE RUN AWAY CHOOSE SOMETHING ELSE

[MARCA] continues to get worse. Every update is worse. More and more clicks. More things hidden. Less intuitive. Ads popping up. Very frustrating as a longtime user to constantly get worse and worse UI updates
Change it back!!!. I’m really disgusted with the update. I have been a [APP] user for a decade. I really hated giving up my [APP] Classic but stuck with it. This latest version is absolutely trash.

Useless, confusing updates pushed out constantly that change the layout and functionality. Unfortunately I have to update my [APP] review again. User since 2019, preached the [APP] way to dozens of my friends and used it to get out of debt. This company does not value user feedback, user experience, or its employees. I thought being a beta tester would help shape the direction of the app, but they don’t even send major UI updates to the beta testing pool before shoving them into the official app. In the past 1 year they have pushed several major, confusing updates to the app layout and interface, where each one has changed the location of buttons (right side to left side), the flow of major tasks (opening to a home page instead of the budget), and required more clicks (half of the transaction screen options hidden by a “See More!” tab). Entering a transaction is the backbone of daily use, but has been made more difficult and time consuming. Many changes were obviously flawed in ways that proper beta testing feedback could have prevented (for example, extremely poor color differentiation between future and past transactions), but since user experience isn’t a priority, they ended up rolling back and fixing these issues after they were released to the general user base, causing more updates and layout/color changes that were completely unnecessary. They have not added popular requests such as spending reports that users have requested for over 10 years. There used to be “Four Rules” of the [APP] method, but they quietly removed those and replaced them with gimmicky made-up words such as “spendfulness.” [APP] spent several years building up an online community for users to interact and teach each other, but they just inexplicably fired some of their most popular social media staff and class trainers with 3 hours notice - after sending us an email survey asking how we feel about using AI in our budgets. Apparently there is a new CEO, and I think the shutdown of their main competitor [MARCA] has given them a god complex. All major signs of active ensh*ttification are blinking red, as they destroy all of their community goodwill for the sake of some arbitrary user engagement metrics. It’s the perfect example of the antisocial rot festering within tech companies these days.

App is Getting Worse. [APP] keeps going backwards.  The app is worse than it used to be, hiding necessary options to “reduce visual clutter”.  It also no longer syncs with banks it used to connect to.

Getting Worse. Been using [APP] for years and the app just gets worse. The price goes up and all we get is “blurple” and a more confusing UI. Every change makes the workflow in the app less efficient. Read your reviews. You are alienating your customer base. You’ve pushed me to look for alternatives and I’m starting to test them in hopes of finding something better. The concept is so good and has helped me so much. Stop ruining your own product.

Progressively Worse. While I like [APP], it has managed to get both worse and more expensive over the years. The UI changes too often and sadly in ways that make it more difficult to use. The “updates” sometimes introduce bugs. I’d rather they keep the application stable and usable than try to justify the price hikes by constantly tweaking the user experience.
Moving in the wrong direction. New leadership is backwards. Degrading app updates, a reduction in content, and overall out of touch with users. Used to be amazing, now it’s garbage.

Does the design team use the app?. What is happening here? Every update moves buttons, it keeps trying to auto populate the wrong categories, it fails to sync for days and then slams me with 30 transactions to link. Just recently it reloaded the budget from like 3 days ago, then went to the actual current correct state, then said I was -$600 to budget, then I had a surplus. Why isn’t this done on device THEN reconciled in the cloud? I have gotten people to use this app and I’m nervous the updates are screwing with them. You shouldn’t have to check your bank app every transaction to make sure [APP] did its job - that is the whole point of [APP]! Enter in there, it checks your bank, done! Truly bad. Our subscription just renewed but I’ll seriously consider leaving next renewal period. I’d rather go back to paper and at least know what’s available to spend.
Does nothing unless you pay. Very sneaky making me give you bunch of info, then make me sign up with email, then finally asking for money.

Too labor intensive. Had high hopes for this but it is way too labor intensive and requires you to go to
Through every line item on your spending to assign it.
The UX is very weak. I’m disappointed and will not renew.

UI/UX Breaking Point. [APP] doesn’t listen to users. Period. 

The iOS UI/UX gets worse with every update. More friction, more clicks, appalling what [APP] has become.

Used to be good but increasingly annoying updates. Every unnecessary update makes a previously simple task slightly harder for no reason. Things that used to be one click are now 3, menus get rearranged, the layout is reformatted, all these compounding inconveniences result in an increasingly unpleasant user experience. Every time it’s arbitrary and adds nothing but is clearly change for the sake of saying it was updated. Looking into alternatives after years of use.

Latest updates make this unusable. I’ve been using [APP] for almost 10 years now, but will have to look for an alternate. The last few rounds of design updates make the app almost unusable. Gratuitous UX choices make the key components difficult to find and add taps where they don’t need to be. Not sure what they’re trying to prove, but it’s certainly not that they’re thinking of their users.

Buggy Issues. When deleting old targets and creating new targets the “money needed by…” doesn’t reset. 
Also, no inflow transaction is showing in any categories even when clearing it.

June 2026 update. You now have to do multiple clicks to clear a transaction. The interface was good, now it’s clunky looking. I wish they would keep it simple. It wasn’t broke before, it didn’t need to be changed.

Update: 6/15/26 well their customer service is run by AI and doing a poor job. I emailed asking a question about wanting to cancel but I wanted to make certain I would avoid a refund back on my original form of payment that I no longer have the account for. Their “customer service agent” did not answer my question nor confirm if I wanted proceed with cancelling my subscription. They CANCELLED my account and I didn’t even have time to download my latest account file. It would have been 9 years down the drain had I not downloaded a copy 3 days before. Customer service is a joke.

UX GETTING WORSE!. Why are there so many unnecessary UX updates? Why arent you solving problems like making reporting better, and instead creating new ones that never existed by creating drop down for in/out flow. There's so many more clicks I need to do submit a transaction now. Im about to leave this app after having been a customer for over 5 yrs. This product and design team should get fired

New version is the worst. I absolutely hate this latest version. Entering transactions I now have to select “more” and scroll down to check “cleared”. That change on top of listing all the categories associated with a payee, even when no money is in that category, just makes the user interface clunky and difficult to read. I’d like to say this helped me reduce spending just to avoid entering the transactions, but all it really did is get me to stop using a budgeting program and that is not a good thing. I really miss the simplicity of the older versions that made this program stand out. All the incremental changes over the years have finally broken it for me.

Delayed Transaction. Transactions are always delayed. Everyday they are delayed. Why is there always a giant notice saying they are delayed. You should tell us that transactions are working as intended and be grateful for it.

Unable to register or sign in. Unable to use the app. I’m prompted to Sign in with [MARCA] or [MARCA] or to use a email and password. None of the options work. When I tried [MARCA] it says the [MARCA] account is not currently linked to a [APP] account and to try email and password. Well, I’ve never used the app so I don’t have an email and password to try. I tried the forgot password option in case I did make an account but I received no emails to any of my accounts. I waited 10 minutes and checked the spam folder it all of them.

There is no way to register a new account so I’m confused and frustrated. I’ve given up on this app and will try something else. 0/5 stars
Gamified garbage for non-adults. I don’t need or want confetti on app startup, with a 10 second cartoon that fearmongers to get my anxiety up.

Web app is great, mobile app less so. I’ve used [APP] for years primarily through the web app, but lately I’ve been trying to use the iOS app more. I don’t know when things started to change but the iOS app is infuriating. Between the unskippable pre-login animation and full screen how-tos that cannot be closed without going through all the steps, I’m finding the app to be untenable. I appreciate trying to tech people how [APP] works, but disallowing any sort of skipping makes for a hostile interface.

From 5 stars to 1. My husband and I have used [APP] for several years, and loved it! It was so helpful for our budget! Then, it stopped connecting to our bank. The few times we were able to get it to reconnect, the amounts that were being debited from our account showed up on [APP] as credits. So the app became completely useless to us at that point. Customer service was almost completely useless, and none of the troubleshooting options they provided worked. It’s frustrating, because we had already paid for a full year, and barely used a few months before it stopped working. Such a waste of money on an app that’s supposed to help you with your money.

[NOME]. Has been charging me repeatedly through apple without any receipt, way to track what has been trying to get into my account, or way to cancel their “free trial no card needed” — just now finding out after 3 weeks of them failing to get my money and one SUCCESSFUL attempt because NOW they’ve emailed me that they’re going to get rid of my information… $35 later 😒

Worst Spending Analyzer. I've used [MARCA], [MARCA] and many other budgeting apps, and I have to say [APP] has the absolute worst spending analyzer that is supposed to "help" you create a budget. It incorrectly categorized several expenses during the process of when it creates a budget for you, and there is no way to recategorize the expenses it pulls. It also missed really obvious recurring bills, like car insurance. I'm really disappointed.

Overpriced and getting worse. I’m a long time [APP] subscriber. Like all tech these days they keep making “improvements” to justify the high price. And the software has gotten blotted and worse. You have to click multiple times for basic functions when you didn’t have to before. Do app developers think the more you click the more you engage or something? This is a growing trend across a lot of tech these days. They don’t know how to keep it simple. Go elsewhere.

Farewell. After three years, I am switching to Copilot Money. On the one hand, [APP] did wonders for my finances. I have truly learned how to manage my credit cards and not carry a balance. Our savings and investments are up. Our bad debt is almost gone. But, it hasn’t been easy. A primary issue is manual and imported transactions not matching up. The interface is not user-friendly. I have wasted so much time trying to figure out why my figures are off and trying to set up my categories in a way that suits me. There are no color customizations and it needs a third tier of subcategories. The app has a section for videos and written material to explain how it thinks on the backend, but they are too general, never addressing the issue I was actually having. The people in the videos don’t get to the point. Rather than just giving me the answer I’m looking for, I have to watch a skit where they’re trying to turn it into a comedy show. The problems increasingly become worse with every major update that adds unnecessary functions, tabs, and other changes. Not only do they make the app more confusing, but they also add steps. For example, when transactions import, I can no longer manage those from the plan page. I have to go to the home page in order to review them. The review page used to be helpful. Now, it has useless features like a bar chart showing me that on average I’m spending less than I make, which you can’t even click on to get more detailed information. I’ve been asking for the same income and expense report that can be accessed on the website to be added to the app so that I could easily see my average spending per category per month in order to update my plan (a basic tenet of budgeting) to no avail. I no longer see income, and even when it was there, it lumped everything together.  Overall, what was a game changer for me just a couple of years ago, is now just cumbersome.

Not only have I contacted their customer service a multitude of times resulting in long drawn out exchanges that rarely fix the issue, but the last time they suggested that I don’t create manual transactions at all and just wait for them to import on their own. In other words, I have to budget on their time not mine and wait days until the import shows up! Even today yet another error. I made a credit card payment a couple of days ago and what is supposed to happen is that I will have a deduction from the account I paid from and a credit to the account I paid to. For unknown reasons, there were three transactions, and that third one doesn’t exist in the real world. This is not the first time that [APP] has created transactions that don’t exist. I had to go into three different accounts and make sure that somehow this didn’t actually happen. Then I had to delete the erroneous transaction and reconcile in [APP]. This is exactly why I’ve canceled my subscription.

Latest update is bad. I have used [APP] for years. Gifted my daughter a subscription and few years ago and she loves it too. It has helped us both stay debt free. But this last update is causing me grief! So glitchy and not nearly as seamless as before.

Why am I clicking things more than I needed a month ago?.
